_doc: The numbers of the tractor beam, mines, asteroids and craft (src/Core/Data/SystemsDef.Tractor.cs reads them), taken from the battle console mockup (docs/mockups/battle-console.html: TRACTOR, MINE, ROCK, SHUTTLE, BARRAGE, craftStep, the classes' mines and fighters), its scene unit of 100 m turned into metres. The tractor is a contest of rounds (openspec/changes/battle-console/design.md 4a; owner, 2026-11-01): Hold powers the beam up for powerup_s, then it takes the target inside reach_km at grip_start_x; each round_s the higher beam value (the energy in the tractor times its health) moves the grip step_per_e a point of difference; a grip at 0 frees the held ship, which takes hold of the holder when the holder's tractor is down or holds with under reverse_ratio_x of its value; a ship that broke free cannot be taken by the same holder for relock_s. The held ship's own speed is damped hold_damp_per_s at full grip, and the tether reels at reel_m_s at full grip times the holder's hull over the held ship's (at most 1), reel_step_m a key press, never under min_tether_m; it is lost past reach_km plus reach_slack_km. An AI crew picks its value once a round, ai_pick_min_e to ai_pick_max_e, spare energy first, then from its weapons. Mines (owner, 2026-11-01: "Mine laying should have a cool down system of 3 seconds") arm in arm_s and go off within trigger_m of an enemy for dmg_hp; dropped drop_astern_m astern, or placed by transporter within transporter_reach_km (the transporter's reach, owner 2026-11-03: "1.5 km only!"). Rocks: a hit costs dmg_hp at speed_ref_m_s (at least speed_floor_x of it) and keeps speed_keep_x of the speed, once a cooldown_s; the micrometeor cloud out to halo_x of the radius grinds grind_dps, scaled by speed (at least grind_floor_x), dealt in whole hit points of grit_whole_hp from grind_ahead_m ahead; a ship's collision radius is hull_radius_x of its length. Fighters fly at speed_m_s, circling orbit_m round what they are after at orbit_rad_s, strike within strike_m every strike_every_s (strike_hit_x a pass, strike_dmg_hp each, a Defences pass taking strafe_mount_hp of a mount, point defence first), on Defend shoot a shot at their ship within defend_reach_m (defend_kill_x a try), are recovered within recover_m, and leave the bay launch_wait_s plus launch_stagger_s each. A disguised shuttle flies at speed_m_s, may be seen through inside suspect_km (catch_per_s a second), and detonates past the shields for dmg_hp times the demo's tough_x, leaving one subsystem sys_left_x of its health. A barrage fires salvo missiles of its grade, one every interval_s, from side_offset_m either side, each hitting hit_x. A ship on a lane run (stance run) turns back once lane_turn_km past what it runs at. In a scene where a tool is lethal (scenarios' lethal), it deals the target's hull plus lethal_overkill_hp, and a barrage missile lethal_hull_share_x of its class's hull. loadouts: what each class carries, by class id (the mockup's ca, dd and ff, and the Krai line by the mockup's pairing ca to krai_ca, dd to krai_ff, ff to krai_cv; the Kelvane line by the same pairing, rv to ca, dd to dd, ff to ff, the battlecruiser as a cruiser, and the carrier its fighters, mockup 23, which park on half its 24 pads in the view, provisional until the combat change); a class not listed carries none.
